title: Speed benchmark: 10-story RC frame
purpose: SP1 at 10 stories: 4 x 3 bays of 25 ft, 8 in slabs as thin shells meshed at 2.5 ft (12,000 shell elements, 3,300 frame elements, beams split at every slab node, about 76,000 equations). Lateral load 20 kips x level number. Timed twice: linear (self-weight, superimposed load, lateral load and 12 modes) and nonlinear (P-Delta static under all three together). ETABS uses its advanced solver on all cores.

settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.diaphragm: none: slabs in-plane stiff by their own shells
settings.solver: ETABS advanced solver, all cores; SkyFrame default (PARDISO when installed)
